material.acceptance_criteria: A duel-routes CI run prints hp_changed=true: the sim lowers a beacon's hp when an enemy skirmisher with an idle pulse_shot behaviour is in weapon range.
material.description: Scenario scenarios/duel-routes places beacon structures (300 hp, no weapon, ground filter) on three routes with side 0 skirmishers at 2 cells and side 1 wardens. Over 200 ticks no beacon hit points change (hp_changed=false in the duel-routes CI job, run 38951283476). The fix belongs in the sim, not in the data.
material.resolution: Units damage a structure on a route; live CI-path probe shows beacon hp change; two-sided check fails on unchanged state.
material.subject: Engine: units do not damage a structure placed on a route
material.witness: verifier gm-orch-3-12-v2 at d045f92: live duel-routes served with CI flags; beacon hp 3/3 at tick 0 to 0/3 at tick 206 gives hp_changed=true; unchanged tick-0 state gives hp_changed=false and fails.
material.witness_plan: Run the duel-routes job after the sim change and read the hp_changed value it prints.

note: Units damage a structure on a route; live CI-path probe shows beacon hp change; two-sided check fails on unchanged state.
